environment.description: Same Django REST API deployed on EKS (cluster: prod-api-cluster) in VPC vpc-2b4c6d8e. Pod runs with serviceAccount 'api-svc' annotated for IRSA (IAM Roles for Service Accounts). The signing key is NEVER loaded into application memory — instead, settings.SIGNING_KEY is set to a stub value 'HSM_DELEGATED' and all HMAC operations are proxied through a sidecar container running a PKCS#11 interface to AWS CloudHSM (cluster ID: cluster-3xk9v2m1). The sidecar validates that the destination URL in signing requests matches an allowlist stored in a ConfigMap (cm/approved-destinations) containing only internal service CIDR 10.128.0.0/16 entries. Pod NetworkPolicy (netpol/api-egress-restrict) denies all egress except: TCP 443 to endpoints matching label 'tier=internal-svc', TCP 8443 to the CloudHSM ENI (sg-0f2a4b6c8d), and UDP 53 to kube-dns. The node's instance metadata service is configured with IMDSv2 (hop limit=1) and the pod's service account token audience is scoped to 'sts.amazonaws.com' only. A Kyverno ClusterPolicy (cpol/block-metadata-access) mutates all pod specs to inject an iptables init container that drops traffic to 169.254.169.254.
